ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (BurningPact.cs:19-22) == cost 1 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF. No Exhaust keyword on the card itself -- the Exhaust hover tip (BurningPact.cs:17) refers to the card it exhausts -- and the sim correctly leaves `exhausts` False.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: select ONE hand card with a null filter and exhaust it if non-null (BurningPact.cs:26-30) == `CardSelectCmd.from_hand(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, 'exhaust')` + `ExhaustCmd.exhaust`, THEN draw (`CardPileCmd.Draw(choiceContext, Cards.BaseValue, Owner)`, line 32, == `DrawCmd.draw(ctx.player, self._cards)`). The order is load-bearing -- the exhaust happens before the draw, so the exhausted card cannot be redrawn -- and is preserved. Burning Pact cannot select itself on either side (Play pile in C#, discard-pile limbo in the sim). BLAST RADIUS, not re-verdicted here per rule 3: `CardSelectCmd.FromHand` auto-selects with no player choice and no RNG when the candidate count is at or below MinSelect (CardSelectCmd.cs:287-290), while the sim's `CombatState.select_cards` always delegates to the installed selector and otherwise falls back to `self._rng.sample` on the shared legacy rng (combat.py:575-581). Already recorded as creature_card_cmds steps 104/105 and guard N10; this card is one of its call sites. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (31).
